periods.summary: With Prime Minister Tsukikage abroad/missing during the Or-Gaule-caused prison-break crisis, Itsuki takes charge of the League Japan Branch. He quickly issues special conscription, temporarily granting student knights authority equivalent to mage-knights and enabling Japan to recapture over ninety percent of escaped prisoners within a week. Later he inspects Ohu-Wagadake Special Prison after Heaven-Guided cultists try to rescue Harima Tendo. Despite the warden's objections, he opens Cocytus, correctly judging that Harima can exploit even a few seconds of system failure. The empty cell confirms Great Flame's escape, and he orders an emergency alert.

key_events.summary: His special conscription decision lets Japan contain the prison-break chaos quickly.
Forces open Cocytus and confirms Harima has escaped.
